interface_contract.scope: Repairs, audits, hardening, provenance changes, research/evidence upgrades, and subsystem evolutions that materially affect ICARUS understanding or operation.
interface_contract.display_policy: Show the change, provenance, verification state, interface effect, and execution-authority boundary. Do not imply deployment or trading authority from a repository change.

entries.title: AION/PARALLAX evidence lineage synchronized
entries.summary: Current AION/PARALLAX evidence contracts, provenance inventory, retrospective labeling, and causal replay foundation were synchronized into the consolidated research branch.
entries.verification: Source commit exists; integration remains research-only until the owning branch is reviewed and merged.
entries.interface_effect: System panel exposes the lineage and current integration state.

entries.title: Causal analog atlas and outcome-gated memory
entries.summary: PARALLAX gained decision-time fingerprints, historical analog retrieval, source ablation, and outcome summaries that hide future or unverified outcomes.
entries.verification: Regression tests were added on the subsystem branch; no production authorization is granted.
entries.interface_effect: System panel reports the causal-memory capability and its research-only boundary.

entries.title: Receipt-time microstructure journal hardened
entries.summary: ARGUS now requires explicit source capabilities and verified source identity for authenticated trade/depth evidence, preserves source-local sequencing, detects tampering, and replays depth causally.
entries.verification: Capability, causal-clock, replay-integrity, tamper, and recovery tests were added.
entries.interface_effect: System panel exposes the evidence-tier and source-integrity hardening instead of leaving it hidden in MCP work.

entries.title: Causal advisory replay and outcome-gated competence
entries.summary: ATHENA now treats actual ingestion as the hard replay boundary, surfaces source-quality and sequence gaps, and updates competence only from verified outcomes recorded after they are actually available.
entries.verification: Causal replay, quality abstention, immutable outcome identity, and research-only learning tests were added.
entries.interface_effect: System panel surfaces the advisory safety state and research-only learning boundary.

entries.title: Current NEXUS hardening reconciled into subsystem branch
entries.summary: The subsystem workstream was reconciled with current NEXUS provenance and validation-hardening changes so the research branch does not silently regress newer main-line safeguards.
entries.verification: Reconciliation commit preserves the current main-line NEXUS hardening in the subsystem branch tree.
entries.interface_effect: System panel makes cross-branch reconciliation visible and traceable.

entries.title: Repository/MCP health surfaced in the trading interface
entries.summary: ICARUS main gained a visible System tab and repository/CI health surface so verified repository audits are visible from the trading dashboard rather than remaining only in GitHub or MCP output.
entries.verification: Merged on main with dashboard and server test coverage for the System tab, audit endpoint, badge, and refresh loop.
entries.interface_effect: The System tab displays repository audit state, main SHA, Linux and Windows checks, audited branches, failures, pending work, and unresolved findings.

entries.title: System-evolution interface contract test repaired
entries.summary: The MCP-to-interface evolution surface changed from the research-status payload to the repository-audit payload; the dashboard contract test was repaired to verify the actual System-tab data path instead of a stale field name.
entries.verification: The repair updates only the stale contract assertions; repository Actions is the authoritative regression check for the branch.
entries.interface_effect: The System evolution & audit panel remains continuously test-covered against /api/system/audit -> evolution.

entries.title: Export/Data Integrity and MCP receipt panel integrated
entries.summary: ICARUS gained a dedicated Data Integrity interface for the export checklist, recovered corpus, representation/data-quality repairs, and idempotent runtime MCP change receipts with exact repository/branch/commit provenance.
entries.verification: The implementation includes fail-closed manifest/journal validation, exact-SHA provenance enforcement, idempotency tests, MCP bridge contract tests, and dashboard JavaScript contract coverage; repository Actions is the final branch verification.
entries.interface_effect: A Data Integrity tab exposes O03/O04/O05/O06/O14, corpus statistics, repaired NEXUS blockers, and future material MCP receipts. The System evolution panel also records this integration.
